truth.expected_fix: Restore EMBED_TIMEOUT_S to 45 s and make the fallback loud (log/raise or at least count and alert) instead of silently answering from hash vectors.

truth.true_cause: EMBED_TIMEOUT_S in embedder.py was lowered from 45 to 10 s.
